function.description: Propose a setting change to the OWNER as a one-tap card (owner turn only). An operator-only setting is filed for the operator and you get its id. Not for money (propose_action).
function.name: propose_setting

command.description: The owner's line: `/mcp add <id> <https-url>`, `/config set <key> <value>`, `/goal grant <id> tools=a,b` or `/job edit <id> grant tools=a,b`.
